name: Megiddo Y.K. Ltd
summary: Megiddo Y.K. Ltd. is a real estate firm dedicated to the initiation, design, and construction of residential properties. The company also specializes in undertaking significant commercial and office developments, including large-scale projects. Established in 1970, Megiddo Y.K. Ltd. has its headquarters in Ramat Gan, Israel, and operates as a subsidiary of Aura Investments Ltd.
